description: iPhone app (and Android twin): NyxEcho in a native shell that loads the live site (server.url) - the same pattern as the NyxEcho repo's native/ folder and Feed the Bear's installed app. Pro is bought on nyxecho.com and unlocks in-app after sign-in; buying UI is hidden inside the shell. This pack lives with the Feed the Bear repo's iOS workflows because that repo's GitHub secrets hold the working App Store Connect key.
name: nyxecho-native
